for path,snapshot in pairs:
 old=ast.parse(pathlib.Path(snapshot).read_text());new=ast.parse(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())
 oldassert=[ast.dump(n) for n in ast.walk(old) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
 newassert=[ast.dump(n) for n in ast.walk(new) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
 if path.endswith('start_stop_admission.py'):
  assert oldassert==newassert
  fn=next(n for n in new.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='test_direct_orze_run_preserves_pid_and_never_acquires_resources')
  call=next(n.value for n in fn.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(x,ast.Name) and x.id=='runner' for x in n.targets))
  added=[x for x in call.keywords if x.arg=='cfg'];assert len(added)==1
  assert ast.dump(added[0].value)==ast.dump(ast.parse('p.cfg',mode='eval').body)
  call.keywords.remove(added[0]);kind='one cfg=p.cfg keyword'
 else:
  changed=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(oldassert,newassert) if a!=b];assert len(changed)==1
  fn=next(n for n in new.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='test_unreadable_marker_probe_refuses_without_treating_it_as_absent')
  assertion=fn.body[-1];assert isinstance(assertion,ast.Assert)
  values=assertion.test.comparators[0].elts
  assert values[0].value=='_controller_registration.lock.source-lock'
  values.pop(0);kind='one exact access-list item before unchanged sentinel sequence'
 assert ast.dump(old)==ast.dump(new)
 out.append({'path':path,'before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(snapshot).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'before_assert_sites':len(oldassert),'after_assert_sites':len(newassert),'approved_change':kind,'whole_AST_identical_after_only_approved_change_removed':True})
print(json.dumps(out))
